description: Pinned at zoom 5.5, inside the animated globe<->mercator projection morph (GLOBE_ZOOM_THRESHOLD_MIN=5..MAX=6). Checks that SymbolBucket#addToPlacement blends the globe-ECEF anchor toward its mercator-projected position (mirroring CollisionIndex#placeCollisionBox) instead of using the raw globe position, which would offset the collision box from the icon mid-transition. Globe and mercator positions match at the map center, so the symbol is placed away from it at a high latitude under a high pitch, where the difference is several pixels.
